描述_EN: the term porcelain is applied to ceramics made from a mixture of a clay called kaolin and a white stone called petuntse, which was fired at high temperatures. porcelains differ from other ceramics in their impermeability, their whiteness and fine texture. xing wares like the dish on the left were very popular both domestically and abroad, and were exported as far away as north africa during the years between 800-1000ad. xing and ding wares were of the earliest true porcelains made in china, and the world. these two dishes are examples of xing ware (left) and ding ware (right). chinese porcelains later achieved great popularity in western europe, although it was not until the early eighteenth century that european makers accurately duplicated true porcelain.
描述_ZN: 瓷器一词适用于由一种叫做高岭土的粘土和一种叫做Petuntse的白色石头的混合物制成的陶瓷，在高温下烧制。 瓷器与其他陶瓷的不同之处在于其不渗透性、白色和精细的纹理。 像左边的盘子这样的兴器在国内外都非常流行，在公元800-1000年期间，被出口到遥远的非洲北部。 邢、定二器是中国乃至世界上最早的真正的瓷器。 这两个盘子是邢器（左）和鼎器（右）的例子。 中国的瓷器后来在西欧大受欢迎，尽管直到18世纪初，欧洲的制造商才准确地复制了真正的瓷器。
